role_dispositions.finding: TriggerEligibility travel/rest booleans have three admitted states; false/false rejected. Travel, Rest, Both enum or nonempty closed trigger set removes invalid state while preserving both-trigger encounters.
role_dispositions.remedy: Encode nonempty trigger selection at authored owner and propagate to selector; no exclusive either/or assumption.

role_dispositions.finding: SpeakerBacking correctly owns character decisions versus narrative/blocked reasons. SpeakerNature is independent of backing in representation but Character backing requires Mortal. Mortal narrative collectives and blocked figures are valid; do not force every mortal to Character. Could consolidate the proved invalid supernatural+Character cross-product without discarding narrative mortal cases.
role_dispositions.trace: Actual materializer only enters SpeakerBacking::Character; uses checked u16 cast ordinal and context/role/decision/name retry comparisons before persistent Character insertion. No catalog name alone substitutes identity.
role_dispositions.remedy: Keep actual contextual Character authority distinct from presentation; if simplifying shape, own mortal Character payload explicitly while retaining non-character nature classification. Review markers are authored assertions, not machine proof of verse.

role_dispositions.finding: SharedCharacterInteraction list duplicates mechanically derivable information/inventory/personality/combat indicators; validator requires exact iff correspondence to effect/transition presence. Treatment/contact have separate ordinary authority and are not inferable merely from item effects. NarrativeOnly excludes mechanics; Blocked remains explicit nonexecutable content state.
role_dispositions.trace: Reducer rejects Blocked, requires ordinary Surgery completion for treatment and skips already-consumed bandage mechanic; then dispatches requirement/check/effect/transition types.
role_dispositions.remedy: Derive mechanical capability tags from typed mechanics or combine payloads with authority shape; keep explicit ordinary treatment/contact ports and blocked follow-up reason. Group only true coupled facts.

role_dispositions.finding: Transition enum owns combat payload and travel delay; Noop and None are behaviorally duplicate at actual reducer1698-1717 (None skips, Noop empty). Use one absence representation. CombatOutcomeSet gives all four distinct outcomes; defeat/stalemate intentionally coalesce while escape/surrender remain distinct. Single RoadCombatArchetype::Bandits is a restricted authored category, not automatically pointless.
role_dispositions.remedy: Remove redundant noop encoding; retain complete per-outcome reward scope. Positive bounded1..8 enemy count and1..720 delay are concrete catalog policies, not global count/time bounds. Non-victory effects intentionally may consume items/currency; forbid only actual reward forms.

role_dispositions.finding: Requirement/Check/Effect sums correctly own distinct payload shapes, but raw quantities lose units and roles: training hours, milli-attribute/skill difficulty, positive item quantity, signed currency change and positive required money. Distinct catalog/choice/speaker/item/information/reward IDs all String. Currency ID validator checks only syntax/catalog existence, while actual apply_narrative_effect additionally checks is_currency_id.
role_dispositions.trace: Negative Currency removes generic party currency after checking declared currency category; positive Currency adds that declared item count. Requirement::Currency counts all currency stacks. Thus denomination quantity versus generic monetary amount association must remain explicit; no universal same-unit Money assumption.
role_dispositions.remedy: Use canonical item/currency identities and purpose-specific quantity owners, share numeric invariants below those roles, admit currency category at catalog owner. Restrict authored skill/personality/religion subsets over canonical owners when that removes duplicate adapters; keep deliberate supported subset policy.
role_dispositions.limits: No actual malformed authored-currency input/runtime claim or full inventory/currency kernel proof; default requirement currency has no explicit denomination, so exact conversion policy remains a qualified authority question.

role_dispositions.finding: Authored ContextualDecisionState is not observer-specific InteractionPresentationDecision. The latter also permits EmergencyTreatment and is gated by live presence/injury/status. Raw treatment_limb_slug Option<String> loses already selected canonical BodyRegion on presentation boundary; assess typed serialization rather than adding another body-region owner.
role_dispositions.remedy: Preserve authored answer, observer affordance, contact revision and membership revision as separate roles; keep actual body region typed until wire formatting. No authorization proof from presentation alone.

role_dispositions.finding: Runtime embedded catalog is validated and item references checked before shared access. Structural open-ID validation and reference existence do not prove every declared category/authority. Full existing fixtures personally read, including poetry/provenance, distinct route materiality, moral tradeoffs, victory-only rewards and bounded delays.
role_dispositions.remedy: Retain compiler/catalog admission and explicit player-safe projections; source-account fixtures without treating prose assertions as actual simulation of each narrated action. All source notes remain frozen/current/alias qualified.
role_dispositions.acceptance: Typed mechanic payloads and purpose quantities survive actual reducer receiving ports; no additional hidden state/animal/sleep/persistent narrative entity inferred from authored text.
